report.summary: A dramatic contemporary tropical estate composed as a low, layered limestone and ivory residence opening southward toward the Caribbean. The design pairs a grand shaded sea-view salon, deep loggias, a long infinity-style pool court, private bedroom wings, an elevated owner’s suite, a sheltered arrival porch, and a separate open elliptical sunset lounge. The scene uses a temporary flat Y=0 site plane; the Saint Lucia hillside, ocean horizon, planting, and terrain grading are not modeled.
unsupported: Sloping Saint Lucia topography, cliff-edge grading, planting, and the Caribbean Sea beyond the property boundary are not represented; generation is constrained to a flat ground plane.
Infinity-edge pool hydraulics, structural engineering, interior fit-out, and bespoke curved architectural shells beyond the approved open pavilion are unsupported.

issues: Programme construction commitments are unrecorded; narrative spaces do not establish built accommodation.
